# Say No to Plastic

Say No to Plastic is a physician-led science-to-action platform about plastics, microplastics, nanoplastics, human exposure, and practical exposure reduction. Homo Plasticus is the book and digital product within the platform.

Configured primary site: https://saynotoplastic.com/
Science ledger: https://saynotoplastic.com/science
Body-system science library: https://saynotoplastic.com/science#body-system-overviews
Detection methods: https://saynotoplastic.com/science/how-detection-works
Exposome framework: https://saynotoplastic.com/science/exposome
Practical exposure-reduction framework and device-local worksheet: https://saynotoplastic.com/solutions/reduce-exposure
Field guides: https://saynotoplastic.com/resources
Book: https://saynotoplastic.com/homo-plasticus
Events, media, and downloadable evidence briefs: https://saynotoplastic.com/media
Press kit and one-page briefings: https://saynotoplastic.com/media/press-kit
Community readings, device-local challenges, and optional email learning series: https://saynotoplastic.com/community
Editorial policy: https://saynotoplastic.com/editorial-policy
Medical disclaimer: https://saynotoplastic.com/medical-disclaimer
Affiliate disclosure: https://saynotoplastic.com/affiliate-disclosure

Important interpretation rule: detection, biological mechanism, observational association, and causation are different levels of evidence. Body-system pages visibly identify whether their primary-source record is verified, partial, or still under source review. Source-review pages are not intended for search indexing until the primary bibliography is attached and approved. Site content is general education and does not provide personal medical advice.

Interactive worksheets and challenges store progress on the visitor's device. The optional ten-part learning series requires explicit consent and may be unavailable until production email operations are configured.
